name: The Studio by Hill Street
description: Adult ballroom and Latin studio in Southampton Village with group classes, private lessons, kids classes and wedding dance prep.
reviewNotes:
Instagram handle is from the studio's press announcement and event listings; the Instagram page itself could not be opened (blocked).

Directory research 2026-10-04: Studio shares the Hill Street Boxing building (33 Hill St). The website FAQ once gives (631) 377-7087 for the front desk, but every other mention (header, contact page, classes page) says (631) 377-3087, so 377-7087 looks like a typo. No opening hours published (booking is through MindBody). Website calls itself adult-focused, but a Sept 2026 Patch listing confirms a kids program, so the current description stands. No Facebook page found. Logo is the horizontal black header version; a stacked square version also exists at /wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Asset-1@4x.png.

evidence.note: Own site: adult ballroom and Latin studio at 33 Hill St, Southampton, NY 11968; first group class free; call (631) 377-3087; booking online and via the MindBody app.
Contact page lists info@thestudiobyhillstreet.com, (631) 377.3087 and the Instagram account.
Local press on the 2025 grand opening: studio is inside the Hill Street Boxing facility at 33 Hill Street.
Patch listing for a fall 2026 kids ballroom and Latin semester at the studio, so the kids classes in our description are still current.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: thestudiobyhillstreet.com, jameslanepost.com, patch.com.
